# Bundled browser dependencies

- SheetJS CE 0.20.3: https://git.sheetjs.com/sheetjs/sheetjs/src/tag/v0.20.3 (Apache-2.0; SHEETJS-LICENSE.txt).
- Tesseract.js 6.0.1: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js (Apache-2.0; tesseract/LICENSE.md).
- Tesseract.js-core 6.1.2: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core (Apache-2.0; tesseract-core/LICENSE.txt).
- Simplified Chinese trained data: https://github.com/naptha/tessdata and https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata (Apache-2.0; tessdata/LICENSE.txt). The precise downloaded model revision is not pinned; do not claim reproducible model provenance.

OCR runs locally in the browser. Recognized dates, periods and text require manual review before import; recognition accuracy is not guaranteed.
